title: Designated Companion Terms — Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
The passes of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes are used with a named companion designated on the pass; the certificates are not. The allowance and price of changing that companion are set out below.

| Product | Named companion must be designated before booking | Changes of the designated companion allowed over the life of the product | Fee per change of the designated companion (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin | no | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus | no | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy | no | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Companion Certificate First | no | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual | yes | 1 | 50 |
| Crestline Companion Pass Annual | yes | 3 | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- A Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual allows 1 change of its designated companion, at 50 USD; a Crestline Companion Pass Annual allows 3 changes at 0 USD each.
- The four certificates require no designation, allow 0 changes and carry a change fee of 0 USD.

**Hypothetical case.** A Pass Semiannual holder who has already used 1 change has no change left; a Pass Annual holder who has used 2 changes still has one.
